theater: 洞庭湖西岸鼎州社木寨

battle.name: 社木寨之戰
battle.theater: 洞庭湖西岸鼎州社木寨
battle.brief: 紹興四年（1134）正月至八月，洞庭湖楊幺水軍與南宋潭鼎湖廣制置使王淵部在鼎州（今湖南常德）反覆拉鋸：宋軍正月於皮真寨小勝，七月漲水衝斷新陂橋，社木寨守將許締被殺、五六百守軍全毀。卡面十字弩是雙方舟師的骨幹火力，車船層層置弩如水上城牆。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 紹興四年（1134）湖南洞庭湖一帶的社木寨之戰，實際上是南宋朝廷與洞庭湖水軍義軍在湖西岸拉鋒八個多月的其中一場水寨攻防。交手的甲方是楊幺水軍，即建炎三年冬天由鍾相在鼎州拉起、鍾相死後由楊幺接掌的那支舟師；義軍以洞庭湖的水面為巢穴，造車船、練水手，靠湖魚湖藕與沿岸搶運維持，兵員多為兩湖漁民與流民，楊欽是旗下主管車船水軍的頭目，多次拒絕南宋招撫。乙方是南宋的平叛體系：主帥是荊南、潭鼎湖廣制置使王淵，鼎州知州程同彥以郡兵身分守城，統制官杜滂、王嚴、趙興等分領人馬，德山沅水對岸、社木寨、舢場寨三處各留兵五百人守備，另有本地弩手與水軍配合。背景上，南宋的精銳多壓在淮東與金人對峙，又先後遇上苗劉兵變與郦瓊叛變，江漢一線兵力空虛，義軍才有條件坐大。整場衝突沒有外敵介入，性質是王朝對付湖上叛兵的內戰式水戰，兵家所謂以水寨當城、以舟師當軍。
countriesEn: The Battle of Shemu Zhai of 1134 took place on the western shore of Dongting Lake in present-day Hunan, inside the Tanzhou-Dingzhou Huguang circuit of the Southern Song. It was in truth one engagement in a series of water-fort sieges that ran for more than eight months between the Song court and the lake insurgents. One side was the fleet of Yang Yao, raised at Dingzhou by Zhong Xiang in the winter of 1129 and inherited by Yang Yao after Zhong's death. The insurgents used the open water of the lake as their stronghold; they built war wagons and boats, trained their oarsmen, lived on lake fish, lotus roots and plunder from the shore, and drew most of their strength from fishermen and displaced families of the two lakes. Yang Qin headed the war-boat force, and the movement repeatedly refused the court's offers of amnesty. The other side was the Southern Song's own suppression apparatus: Wang Yuan as commissioner of Jingnan and Tanzhou-Dingzhou Huguang, Cheng Tongyan as prefect of Dingzhou commanding the local militia, and line commanders such as Du Pang, Wang Yan and Zhao Xing. About five hundred men were stationed at each of three posts - Deshan on the far bank of the Yuan River, Shemu Zhai itself and Shanchangzhai - with local crossbowmen and river troops in support. The wider context was that Song strength was committed to the eastern front against the Jin, while the Miao-Liu mutiny and Li Qiong's revolt had emptied the middle Yangtze. No foreign power intervened: this was a civil war of a dynasty against a rising, fought with water-forts standing in for walls and river fleets standing in for field armies.
people: 楊幺是這場戰役的實際主角。他是鼎州出身，早年在洞庭湖上以漁民身分聚眾，鍾相起義之後眾人推他為首，他所造的車船是洞庭水軍的技術核心，被宋廷視為最難對付的攻城利器。楊欽在七月率車船水軍奇襲社木寨，是攻破寨防的執行者。官軍方面，荊南、潭鼎湖廣制置使王淵於一一三三年率軍入湖，在下游陽武口一役先敗，翌年再至鼎州主持第二次進剿，又被義軍擊潰，戰局改由他人接手。鼎州知州程同彥負責城防與各寨的兵源調度，正月初七派統制官杜滂會同王嚴、趙興出戰，初九在皮真寨小勝，斬義軍頭目陳鈐等八十餘人、奪船三十隻。社木寨守將許締守到最後，被楊軍殺死。八月之後朝廷改派岳飛率軍大規模進剿，翌年二月楊幺兵敗自投洞庭湖而死，洞庭之亂始平，社木寨的敗局也就此拖出了結尾。
peopleEn: Yang Yao is the real protagonist of this campaign. A native of Dingzhou, he had gathered a following among the lake fishermen long before the rising, and after Zhong Xiang's death the insurgents pushed him to the head of the movement. His war wagons and boats were the technical heart of the Dongting fleet and were treated by the Song court as the most awkward siege weapon of the whole rebellion. Yang Qin led the war-boat force that stormed Shemu Zhai in the seventh month and carried the assault through the breach. On the Song side, Wang Yuan, commissioner of Jingnan and Tanzhou-Dingzhou Huguang, marched into the lake in 1133 and was beaten at Yangwukou on the lower reaches; returning to Dingzhou the next year for a second campaign he was broken again, and command passed to other hands. Cheng Tongyan, prefect of Dingzhou, handled the city's defence and the manning of the river posts: on the seventh day of the first month he sent out the line commanders Du Pang, Wang Yan and Zhao Xing, and on the ninth they took Pizhenzhai, killing the insurgent leader Chen Qian and eighty-odd others and capturing thirty boats. The garrison commander of Shemu Zhai, Xu Di, held out to the end and was killed by Yang's men. In the eighth month the court replaced the command with Yue Fei and a large-scale offensive; in the second month of the following year Yang Yao was defeated, drowned himself in the lake, and the rebellion was ended - the failure of Shemu Zhai thus closed the story.
kits: 弩是這場水戰裡最吃重的火器。義軍車船的特點是內外有板、層層置弩，弩手與水軍同船，甲板上一列列弩手，射界可以覆蓋到接近己方船舷的距離，楊軍再以撞竿與飛石壓制寨牆，最後靠船體硬撞寨門。南宋官軍的裝備同樣以弩為骨幹，《宋史·兵志》所列的宋弩有弓弩、臂弩、蹶張弩、彍弩與神臂弓：蹶張弩以腳蹬張弦，發射猛而裝填慢，神臂弓更以臂機加力，射遠穿甲，正合守寨牆之需；兵種上有專司的弩手與彍弩手，也有把床子弩架在檣旁或船板上作固定射擊位。弓仍是遠射骨幹，槍、刀、楯是登船接戰的兵器，兩軍皆備皮甲與鐵甲。官軍在水路靠艌公、走舸與制式戰船，義軍靠自造車船與漁船改裝；糧秣方面，義軍仰賴湖產與沿岸搶運，官軍的接濟全靠水路轉運。卡面所繪的歐式十字弩以機械絞盤張弦，與宋人的蹶張、神臂同屬「把射速交給機械」的思路；這場戰役正好印證其代價：裝填遲緩的弩在有充足射界的水寨與車船對峙中佔盡便宜，一旦失去射界，或像社木寨那樣被洪水與斷橋困住，弩的遲緩就變成致命弱點。
kitsEn: The crossbow was the weightiest missile of this water fight. The insurgent war boats were built with boards inside and outside and with crossbows tiered on deck: the crossbowmen sailed in the same hulls as the oarsmen, their firing arcs reaching almost to the sides of their own vessels, while the fleet used rams and stone-throwers to batter the stockade wall before driving the hulls against the gate. The Southern Song's own equipment rested on the crossbow as well. The Military Treatise of the Song lists for the dynasty bows drawn by a stirrup, lever bows, the strong-armed crossbow and the great arm crossbow: the stirrup-drawn crossbow was cocked with the feet, threw heavy bolts but was slow to reload, and the great arm crossbow added a lever mechanism, shooting far and piercing armour, which is exactly what a river stockade wanted. The troops included dedicated crossbowmen and light crossbowmen, and bed-mounted crossbows set on the side of a boat or a ship as fixed firing positions. The bow remained the backbone of long-range shooting; spear, sabre and shield were the close-fighting arms for boarding, and both sides wore leather and iron armour. On the water the Song used flat-bottomed boats, light skiffs and regular warships, while the insurgents relied on their own war wagons and on fishing boats converted for use. Food came from the lake and from raids ashore for the insurgents, while the court's supplies could only be shifted by water. The crossbow on the card, cocked by a mechanical windlass, belongs to the same idea as the Chinese stirrup and lever bows: the rate of fire was handed over to a mechanism. This campaign shows the price of that bargain. The slow-loading crossbow was worth everything when a stockade or a war boat offered it a wide arc of fire, but once the arc was gone, or when flood and a broken bridge pinned the defenders down as at Shemu Zhai, that slowness became fatal.
tactics: 義軍的戰法幾乎全建在湖上：以洞庭湖的廣闊水面換取轉向與隱蔽，車船充當浮動堡壘，前排以撞竿、飛石壓迫寨牆，弩手在甲板層層配置，輪番射擊以維持火力密度；突進時只挑精銳鐵甲士卒乘少數軍船直插宋軍水寨的薄弱處，待宋軍舟師被分割、補給線被切斷，再以多船合圍殲滅。官軍則是典型的郡縣防守加反覆出擊：程同彥把五百人分駐數個水寨，王淵兩度自鄂州沿江入湖，每次都先派小股舟師試探、被楊軍以車船反制，退回鼎州再整軍，屢以「出戰無功」告終。問題出在分散駐守：社木寨、德山、舢場寨彼此不能互相支援，一處被圍，其餘無船可救；新陂橋被漲水衝斷之後，寨中守軍既無船轉運、也無糧械可補，弩手雖仍能射，卻無法把射擊成果變成退走的船。八月後岳飛接手，改以大軍壓境、水陸並進、斷糧道與招撫並行，逼義軍在湖上與官軍主力硬拼。
tacticsEn: The insurgents fought almost entirely on the lake. The wide water of Dongting gave them turning room and concealment, and the war boats served as floating bastions: rams and stone-throwers worked at the stockade wall from the front while crossbowmen were tiered on the decks, firing in rotation to keep up the density of the barrage. When they attacked, they took only a small number of war boats carrying armoured picked troops, drove them straight at the weak point of the Song river post, and once the Song flotilla had been split and its supply line cut, closed on it from several sides to destroy it piecemeal. The Song manner was the classic militia defence of a prefecture combined with repeated sorties: Cheng Tongyan scattered five hundred men across several river posts, and Wang Yuan entered the lake twice from Ezhou along the river, each time sending out small flotillas to probe, being countered by the war boats, and falling back to Dingzhou to reform, ending each campaign with the verdict that his battles had achieved nothing. The weakness was that the posts were dispersed. Shemu Zhai, Deshan and Shanchangzhai could not support one another; when one was surrounded, the others had no boats to help. After the rising water broke the Xinpi bridge, the garrison of Shemu Zhai had neither craft to shift its stores nor any route to bring them in. The crossbowmen could still shoot, but their shooting could not be turned into a boat to leave in. When Yue Fei took over in the eighth month, the method changed: masses of troops pressing the lake, land and water working together, supply lines cut, and offers of amnesty combined, forcing the insurgents to face the main body of the imperial army in the open water of the lake.
data: 與這場戰役直接相關的數字，見於《宋史·岳飛傳》《建炎以來繫年要錄》一類記載以及後人整理的戰役條目，數目不多，但輪廓清楚。時間上，義軍在陽武口與光港的兩次出擊在紹興三年（一一三三年）冬，社木寨一役在紹興四年七月，宋廷貶王淵、派岳飛進剿在同年八月，其後一一三五年二月楊幺敗亡，前後跨度約八個月。一一三三年楊軍出動的精銳戰船為八隻，滿載鐵甲士卒突擊光港方向；一一三四年正月初七程同彥遣杜滂等出戰，初九克皮真寨，斬陳鈐等八十餘人，奪船三十隻。德山沅水對岸、社木寨、舢場寨三處各駐兵五百人。社木寨失守時，寨中官兵五六百人全數覆沒，守將許締陣亡。義軍前後投入的舟船在數十艘的量級，車船的確切數目未見確數，僅知其可在船隊中輪番投入突擊。這組數字說明一場水寨攻防的實際規模：官軍分兵駐守，每處僅數百人；義軍則集中使用少數大船，把兵員與器械壓在一處。
dataEn: The figures that survive for this campaign come from the Song History biography of Yue Fei, the chronicle of events from the Jianyan era onward and later battle compilations. They are few, but they fix the shape of the affair. In time, the insurgent thrusts at Yangwukou and Guanggang belong to the winter of 1133; the storming of Shemu Zhai belongs to the seventh month of 1134; the court removed Wang Yuan and sent in Yue Fei in the eighth month of the same year; and Yang Yao's death came in the second month of 1135, so the whole business spans about eight months. In 1133 the insurgents put eight war boats into the lake, fully manned with armoured men, against the Song positions in the direction of Guanggang. On the seventh day of the first month of 1134 Cheng Tongyan sent out Du Pang and his colleagues, and on the ninth they took Pizhenzhai, killing the insurgent leader Chen Qian and eighty-odd others and taking thirty boats. Three posts - Deshan on the far bank of the Yuan River, Shemu Zhai and Shanchangzhai - each held five hundred men. When Shemu Zhai fell, the five hundred or six hundred officers and soldiers in it were wiped out and the garrison commander Xu Di was killed. The insurgents' fleet was on the order of several dozen craft; the exact number of war boats is not recorded, only that they could be thrown into an attack in turn. These numbers describe the real scale of a water-fort siege: the Song split its garrison into posts of a few hundred men, while the insurgents concentrated a handful of large vessels and pressed men and equipment into them.
cause: 社木寨會失守，根源在紹興初年南宋對洞庭湖的失控。建炎三年（一一二九年）冬，鍾相在鼎州起義，佔據洞庭湖的水面與沿岸泊地，翌年鍾相死後，楊幺接手，把義軍推向湖心，以漁船與車船立寨。義軍之所以能坐大，一半是因為南宋自顧不暇：苗劉兵變牽動杭州朝廷，紹興二年郦瓊在池州叛降偽齊，荊湖與江南的官軍被抽往江淮與西線，鼎州一線只剩知州程同彥所領的郡兵與水寨守軍，攻守之勢自然逆轉。南宋屢次招撫未果，一一三三年起改以荊南、潭鼎湖廣制置使王淵領兵進剿，結果在陽武口先敗；王淵再至鼎州仍不能取勝，社木寨等地又因分兵而空虛。社木寨的戰略位置也解釋了為何它成為關鍵：它卡在鼎州東面的水路上，護住由沅水、澧水通往洞庭的門戶；一旦失守，義軍的車船便可直抵鼎州城下水門，官軍再無從把兵與糧送進城內。
causeEn: Shemu Zhai fell because the Southern Song had lost control of Dongting Lake in the early Shaoxing years. In the winter of 1129 Zhong Xiang rose at Dingzhou, taking the surface of the lake and the mooring places along its shore; after Zhong's death the following year Yang Yao took over and pushed the insurgents out into the heart of the lake, founding his strongholds on fishing boats and war boats. Half the reason the rising could grow was that the Song could not attend to it. The Miao-Liu mutiny disturbed the court at Hangzhou, and in the second year of Shaoxing Li Qiong rebelled at Chizhou and went over to the puppet state of Qi, drawing the garrisons of Jinghu and Jiangnan away to the eastern front and the western line. Dingzhou was left with nothing but the prefect's local militia and the river-post garrisons, and the balance of attack and defence turned accordingly. Every amnesty failed, and from 1133 the court tried force instead, sending Wang Yuan as commissioner of Jingnan and Tanzhou-Dingzhou Huguang; he was beaten at Yangwukou. He returned to Dingzhou and still could not win, while Shemu Zhai and the other posts stood empty because their garrisons had been split up. The position of Shemu Zhai also explains why it mattered: it sat on the water route east of Dingzhou, covering the gateway by which the Yuan and Li rivers reach the lake. Once it was lost, the war boats of the insurgents could come straight to the water gate below Dingzhou's wall, and the Song had no way left to bring men and grain into the city.
impact: 社木寨淪陷，後果不止一寨。對南宋而言，這是潭鼎湖廣防區第一次被洞庭義軍正面突破：王淵貶官，朝廷被迫把岳飛從長江防務調往湖南，戰役主導權交給一支正在整訓的西北軍。此後的平叛以多路大軍、斷糧與招撫並行，一一三五年二月楊幺兵敗自投洞庭湖而死，其部眾多降，殘餘轉為流寇的曹成部亦於其後被平定，洞庭湖自此重歸朝廷控制，水軍編制被改編納入荊湖南路防務。技術面上，這一役也留下兩個教訓：一是水寨與車船之間的攻防把弩的價值推到頂點——弩在有射界時的精確與穿甲遠勝長弓，但裝填遲緩，一旦斷了水路、斷了橋，射得再準也換不到一條退路；二是車船這種把城牆搬到水上的思路，證明只要不被斷糧、不被分割，浮動堡壘在缺乏水軍的守軍面前極為有效。這兩點後來都記入南宋的水軍與器械訓練，也是後世評價宋金水戰時常被引用的案例。
impactEn: The loss of Shemu Zhai meant more than one stockade. For the Southern Song it was the first time the Tanzhou-Dingzhou Huguang defence zone had been broken open by the Dongting insurgents: Wang Yuan was removed, the court had to pull Yue Fei away from his work on the Yangtze defences, and command of the campaign passed to a northwestern force that was still being trained. The suppression that followed combined several columns of troops, cutting of supplies and offers of amnesty. In the second month of 1135 Yang Yao was defeated and drowned himself in the lake, most of his followers surrendered, the remnant that turned into roaming bands under Cao Cheng was broken up afterwards, and Dongting Lake returned to the court's control with its naval units reorganised into the Jinghu Nan circuit. On the technical side the campaign left two lessons. First, the duel between the river post and the war boat pushed the value of the crossbow to its peak: the accuracy and armour-piercing power of a crossbow with a clear arc of fire far exceeded that of the long bow, but the slow reload meant that once the water route and the bridge were cut, the best shooting bought no boat to leave in. Second, the war boat - a wall carried onto the water - proved enormously effective against defenders who lacked a fleet, provided it was neither starved nor divided. Both points were later written into Southern Song naval drill and ordnance training, and both are frequently cited when later generations assess Song-Jin fighting on the water.
result: 社木寨的結局是明確的失敗。七月漲水，新陂橋被衝斷，寨中守軍無船可轉運，楊軍首領楊欽以車船水軍攻入，殺守將許締，官軍五六百人全數覆沒，鼎州城外的東面水門自此洞開。義軍取得主動，但戰局並未就此收束——八月王淵以出戰無功被貶官，朝廷派岳飛率軍大規模進剿，義軍在洞庭湖上被逐步壓縮、斷糧，最終在紹興五年二月全軍潰敗，楊幺投湖自盡，部眾或降或散，一部分併入曹成等流寇，洞庭湖一帶的割據武裝被平定。從較長的視角看，這場戰爭以義軍的失敗、而南宋重新控制洞庭湖告終；但它同時暴露了南宋在水戰體系上的空白：郡兵式防守分散，弩兵雖多而水軍船少，器械之利未能轉成戰果。其結果是南宋第一次在水鄉用上大規模的正規水陸配合部隊，也第一次把水軍當作獨立兵種長期經營，弩與車船的組合則在後來的采石等水戰中再度被拿來對照與修正。
resultEn: The outcome at Shemu Zhai was an outright defeat. In the seventh month the rising water broke the Xinpi bridge, the garrison had no craft with which to shift its stores, Yang Qin's war-boat force drove in, the garrison commander Xu Di was killed, and the five hundred or six hundred defenders were wiped out, leaving the eastern water gate below Dingzhou open. The insurgents had the initiative, but the campaign did not end there. In the eighth month Wang Yuan was removed for battles that achieved nothing, the court sent Yue Fei in with a large force, and the insurgents were steadily compressed in the lake and starved, until in the second month of 1135 their whole force broke up and Yang Yao drowned himself; some of his people surrendered, some scattered, and a part joined the roving bands under Cao Cheng, so that the armed separatism around Dongting was put down. In the longer view the war ended with the defeat of the insurgents and the recovery of the lake by the Southern Song, but it also exposed the emptiness in the Song war system on water: defence dispersed among militia posts, many crossbowmen but few river craft, and advantages in ordnance that never turned into results. The practical consequence was that the Song mounted its first large regular force combining land and water in a lake district, treated the navy as an independent arm for the long term, and later compared and corrected its crossbow-and-war-boat doctrine against the fighting at places such as Caishi.
